# A part with one expensive face to integrate

Original synthetic Apache-2.0 fixture for quiddity#307 item 3 (the per-face integration
budget), generated by `tools/make_integration_budget_fixture.py` with build123d. No customer
geometry is used.

`integration_budget_sheet.step.gz`: a 60 × 40 × 20 block with a d8 through hole along z,
its top cut by a dense B-spline sheet (a gentle wave interpolated through a 48 × 32 grid of
points, about 12..14 mm above the base). Unbounded, the sheet's area and moment integration
takes 829,840 work units (integrand evaluations); the next costliest face, the bore, 47,936;
the planes 5,712..13,104. A budget between the sheet's cost and the bore's refuses the sheet
alone (`tests/integration_budget.rs`).
